_comment: Combined and adversarial gate.py probes for boundary-suite.sh. Runs and report use the defaults of release-gate-test.sh (target SHA T, app 15368, check suite 100, all criteria passed on T with the trusted digest). Run overrides: T and OLD are replaced by the SHAs; other keys are set on the run object. Report values: "@ALL" expands to the criterion IDs of the criteria file the probe uses, "@ALLPAD" to the same IDs with injection-shaped text appended. criteria_drop removes criteria rows from a copy of criteria.md (approved.sha256 is copied unchanged). Injection-shaped text is fictional and only tests that it does not change the verdict. 'see' names cases in fixtures/release-gate-cases.json that cover the single-factor version of the same check.

cases.attack: A check run whose name carries injected instructions, followed by a success, does not stand in for the required check
